links.outcome: Concordance of ChatGPT responses with NASS guideline recommendations for lumbar disc herniation
links.effect: ChatGPT-3.5 accurate in 15/29 (52%); ChatGPT-4 accurate in 17/29 (59%); incompleteness in 11 (38%) and 8 (23%) responses.
links.quote: Out of 29 clinical guidelines evaluated, ChatGPT-3.5 demonstrated accuracy in 15 responses (52%), while ChatGPT-4 achieved accuracy in 17 responses (59%).

links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM outputs against guideline reference standard, including overconclusiveness
links.effect: Overconclusive in 14 responses (48%) for ChatGPT-3.5 and 13 (45%) for ChatGPT-4, with accuracy of only 52% and 59%.
links.quote: ChatGPT-3.5 was overconclusive in 14 responses (48%), while ChatGPT-4 exhibited overconclusiveness in 13 responses (45%).

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and completeness of ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4 responses against clinical spine guidelines without testing a deployment safeguard or practice.
